settings.candidate: Sample spacing<=1p; radius4p; nearest32 samples; first8 distinct neighbors/sample; original sorted-score symmetric cap8/carrier; score and stable-ID ordering copied exactly from final v04.
settings.fits: Maximum30000 attempts for this single pass, counting rejected fits identically. Straight TLS then ordered polyline; exactly3 Huber iterations, delta0.5p; equal occupied1p-bin weight; knot spacing<=4p, <=128 knots, <=8192 kernels; EPS=1e-8.
settings.geometry: All-member residual<=1p, q95<=0.5p, tangent<=30deg. Endpoint gap<=1.5p, connector<=35deg. Monotone overlap>=min(2p,half shorter length). Vertex turn<=30deg, every8p absolute turn<=60deg; no new cycles or nonadjacent contact<0.5p.
settings.separation: Preserve v04 parallel guard: overlap>=2p, angle<=15deg, median transverse separation>0.5p rejects. Preserve three-arm branch guard: separation>20deg, each>=3 seedlets spanning>=2p.
settings.competition: Original15% near-tie rule and duplicate-equivalence test; <=2 auxiliary alternatives; no auxiliary evidence establishes topology. At most one topology merge/carrier.
settings.activation: New primary group requires>=3 seedlets, >=6 kernels and >=4p deduplicated support; incumbent assignments preserved.
